prompt: The repository is in /work/repo. The memory watch of the pair setup stops the Qwen server when the available memory falls below a floor. Find the script that sets this floor and its default value in MB. Give the path relative to /work and the line number.

reference.answer: repo/pair_watch.sh:15 sets FLOOR_MB=${FLOOR_MB:-2048}: the default floor is 2048 MB.
